_note: Newspaper transition timings. Times in seconds; 'at' times are seconds into the fade-in; distances in 1920x1080 pixels; angles in degrees; rates in radians per second. A '_min' / '_extra' pair is a random value from min to min + extra. fade_out_s: the papers fly in. The papers fly off at scatter_at_s for scatter_s (the end of the fade-in); the shop starts to show between them reveal_after_s after scatter_at_s. flap_squash: how thin a flapping page gets.

arrive._note: the papers flying in, in parts (0 to 1) of the fade-out: page k (0 first, 1 last) starts at spread * k, give or take jitter / 2, and takes duration_min + duration_extra. It comes from up to from_y / 2 above or below, arcs by arc, spins in by spin_deg and flaps flap times while flying; ease is the power of its slow-down, spin_ease the power of its turn.

leave._note: the papers flying off, in seconds from scatter_at_s: the top page first, page k (0 first, 1 last) at spread * (1 - k) plus up to jitter; each ends end_margin_s before the scatter does. It flies to up to to_y / 2 above or below; ease is the power of its speed-up; it lifts off the pile at lift_rate per unit of its flight.

drift._note: every page drifts while it lies: x_px at x_rate, y_px at y_rate, turn_deg at turn_rate

title._note: spin_s: the title slams in from start_scale, start_turn_deg further turned, fading in at fade_in_rate per unit of the spin, ease the power of its slow-down. land_s: a short press of land_press and the pile under it jolts by jolt_px. Then it is flicked off to the left at leave_at_s for leave_s, to leave_to_x left of the screen, rising rise_px, turning turn_deg and growing by grow at grow_rate. It sways by sway_px at sway_rate and turns sway_deg at sway_turn_rate (phase sway_turn_phase).
